title: Sump Humidity vs Rainfall Correlation
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sump:humidity
| search rain_mm=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(relative_humidity_pct) as avg_relative_humidity_pct avg(rain_mm) as avg_rain_mm by _time rain_window
| sort - _time
description: Tracks sump humidity during rainfall windows over time and breaks it out by rain window.
value: Rain-window splits help confirm whether the moisture problem is really weather-driven or more constant.
implementation: Send sump humidity during rainfall windows events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of sump humidity during rainfall windows by rain window.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how sump humidity during rainfall windows changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
